author: Jerseys
body:
Yo.

My name is Zeriony or Dynamo as most people call me. 

I can get 6-8 clicks per second however when jitter I get roughly 10-12, I mostly play support however I can play defence , front-lines and objective getter. Also I can make TNT cannons really fast. I can shift-bridge and stair-case really fast. I'm not that good with a bow, but at least decent.

Here are videos of me pvping  :

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R8XQRzw6q9U

And more to come.


- Dynamo
